NeoECOPLATINUM
650W
FULL MODULAR ATX12V POWER SUPPLY
The new NeoECO Platinum series is ready to provide PC gamers the exceptional performance with the features of the latest ATX & EPS standard, outstanding stability, and 80 PLUS Platinum certification. The advanced thermal control with the Zero RPM mode enables to turn the fan off at low loads to provide absolute silence. With the 120 mm silent fan, the NeoEco Platinum can optimize the balance between cooling and noise. High-quality Japanese heavy-duty caps can provide your system more stable performance. The CircuitShield™ design serves your industry-grade protection to make your system safe in any environment. With the 7-year warranty, the NeoECO Platinum series will be the most reliable choice for professional users and PC gamers.
80 PLUS Platinum Certified
Japanese Heavy-Duty Caps
Japanese capacitors ensure the tightest DC stability and regulation, for reliability that you and your system can count on.
PhaseWaveTMLLC + DC to DC Design
A server-class Half-Bridge LLC design with synchronous rectification based on a DC-DC topology to improve performance and stability.
Zero RPM Mode
The Zero RPM fan mode further automatically ensures zero fan speed at low loads to reduce plenty of noise and keep absolute silence.
7-year Warranty
The new NeoECO Platinum series from Antec pushes the standard for excellence with the circuit shield suite of industrial protections and is backed by a 7-year warranty.
120 mm Silent Fan
Features improvement for airflow and excellent durability.
Full Modular
Enables users to use only the cables which are needed and help clear out excess cables that can obstruct and reduce airflow.
